column1: # Seconds each test file (pytest suites) or tests/rust module (Rust
# integration suite) took per backend, read from the job logs of the merge
# group run for c5fe7818 on 2026-10-30. The cassandra column holds the
# main and comprehensive suites, read from the cassandra-pytest job of the
# push run for d35d8601a on 2026-11-06. A "-" is a value that was not
# measured. devtools/test-shards uses them only to balance shards: a file
# missing here is weighted by its test count, and a stale value can make
# one shard slower but cannot drop a test, because CI checks that the
# shards together collected every test of the whole suite
